description: The KINP equivalence layer and its firewall (koine/specs/identity.md §4). Links between identifiers are assertions carrying confidence(_)/src(_) (§4.2); only same_as licenses fact transfer, so a fictional entity modeled on a real one is based_on and its in-fiction claims never reach the real entity (§4.3), and a based_on chain is never promoted to same_as by transitivity (§4.5). The rules in each kb mirror packages/core/src/identity/equivalence-predicates.ts verbatim; a native engine consults the same clauses. Bindings stay scalar — every id/3 column is projected through id_local/2 or id_namespace/2 (see README § 'KINP identifiers in the corpus').

cases.name: equiv-link-normalizes-both-link-arities
kb: same_as(id(ent, pinakes, 'napoleon-i'), id(ent, wikidata, q517), confidence(1.0), src('pinakes:anchor/wikidata')).
equiv_link(same_as, A, B, C, src(unattributed)) :- same_as(A, B, C).
equiv_link(same_as, A, B, C, S) :- same_as(A, B, C, S).
equiv_link(based_on, A, B, C, src(unattributed)) :- based_on(A, B, C).
equiv_link(based_on, A, B, C, S) :- based_on(A, B, C, S).

cases.name: link-confidence-is-read-without-string-surgery
kb: equiv_link(based_on, A, B, C, src(unattributed)) :- based_on(A, B, C).
link_confidence(Rel, A, B, Conf) :- equiv_link(Rel, A, B, confidence(Conf), _).
renaud_confidence(C) :- link_confidence(based_on, id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), id(ent, pinakes, 'napoleon-i'), C).

cases.name: same-as-closure-is-symmetric-and-transitive
kb: same_as(id(ent, pinakes, 'napoleon-i'), id(ent, wikidata, q517), confidence(1.0)).
equiv_link(same_as, A, B, C, src(unattributed)) :- same_as(A, B, C).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, B), \+ kinp_member(B, Seen).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, M), \+ kinp_member(M, Seen), same_as_reach(M, B, [M|Seen]).
argos_same_as(NS, L) :- same_as_closure(id(ent, analyzer, 'e-8842'), X), id_namespace(X, NS), id_local(X, L).

cases.name: based-on-is-never-in-the-same-as-closure
kb: same_as(id(ent, pinakes, 'napoleon-i'), id(ent, wikidata, q517), confidence(1.0)).
equiv_link(same_as, A, B, C, src(unattributed)) :- same_as(A, B, C).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, B), \+ kinp_member(B, Seen).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, M), \+ kinp_member(M, Seen), same_as_reach(M, B, [M|Seen]).

cases.name: inspired-by-traverses-based-on-lineage
kb: equiv_link(based_on, A, B, C, src(unattributed)) :- based_on(A, B, C).
inspired_by(F, S) :- based_on_edge(F, M), inspired_by(M, S).
inspiration(FictionLocal, NS, L) :- inspired_by(F, S), id_local(F, FictionLocal), id_namespace(S, NS), id_local(S, L).

cases.name: in-fiction-claims-do-not-reach-the-real-entity
kb: same_as(id(ent, pinakes, 'napoleon-i'), id(ent, wikidata, q517), confidence(1.0)).
claim(id(ent, pinakes, 'napoleon-i'), ruled, id(ent, pinakes, france), '@world'(id(world, pinakes, 'consensus-reality'))).
equiv_link(same_as, A, B, C, src(unattributed)) :- same_as(A, B, C).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, B), \+ kinp_member(B, Seen).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, M), \+ kinp_member(M, Seen), same_as_reach(M, B, [M|Seen]).
fact_of(Id, P, O, W) :- claim(Id, P, O, '@world'(W)).
fact_of(Id, P, O, W) :- same_as_closure(Id, Other), claim(Other, P, O, '@world'(W)).
real_fact(Id, P, O) :- consensus_reality(W), fact_of(Id, P, O, W).
napoleon_fact(P, L) :- real_fact(id(ent, pinakes, 'napoleon-i'), P, O), id_local(O, L).

cases.name: the-in-fiction-claim-does-not-transfer-in-any-world
kb: equiv_link(same_as, A, B, C, src(unattributed)) :- same_as(A, B, C).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, B), \+ kinp_member(B, Seen).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, M), \+ kinp_member(M, Seen), same_as_reach(M, B, [M|Seen]).
fact_of(Id, P, O, W) :- claim(Id, P, O, '@world'(W)).
fact_of(Id, P, O, W) :- same_as_closure(Id, Other), claim(Other, P, O, '@world'(W)).

cases.name: firewalled-holds-for-a-lineage-without-same-as
kb: equiv_link(same_as, A, B, C, src(unattributed)) :- same_as(A, B, C).
equiv_link(based_on, A, B, C, src(unattributed)) :- based_on(A, B, C).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, B), \+ kinp_member(B, Seen).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, M), \+ kinp_member(M, Seen), same_as_reach(M, B, [M|Seen]).
inspired_by(F, S) :- based_on_edge(F, M), inspired_by(M, S).
firewalled(F, S) :- inspired_by(F, S), \+ same_as_closure(F, S).
firewalled_pair(FL, SL) :- firewalled(F, S), id_local(F, FL), id_local(S, SL).

cases.name: provisional-local-is-usable-before-reconciliation
kb: fact_of(Id, P, O, W) :- claim(Id, P, O, '@world'(W)).
provisional_fact(P, L) :- fact_of(id(ent, 'insimul:local', 'tmp-npc-42'), P, O, _), id_local(O, L).

cases.name: reconciling-a-provisional-local-adds-same-as-without-moving-its-claims
kb: equiv_link(same_as, A, B, C, S) :- same_as(A, B, C, S).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, B), \+ kinp_member(B, Seen).
same_as_reach(A, B, Seen) :- same_as_edge(A, M), \+ kinp_member(M, Seen), same_as_reach(M, B, [M|Seen]).
fact_of(Id, P, O, W) :- claim(Id, P, O, '@world'(W)).
fact_of(Id, P, O, W) :- same_as_closure(Id, Other), claim(Other, P, O, '@world'(W)).
canonical_fact(P, L) :- fact_of(id(ent, 'insimul:world:alderforest', 'npc-renaud'), P, O, _), id_local(O, L).
